1a052dfd: ;
 .;The routine is called if the patient movement entry exists in the
 .;INCOMPLETE RECORDS TRACKING file 393. The routine retrieves
 .;the patient's internal entry number (IEN) in the PATIENT file 2
 .;from the 0th node of file 393. The patient's DFN is obtained
 .;from the IEN value.
22a93d64: ;The variable DGJTNO is set to the 0th node of file 393 and DFN is assigned the patient's IEN.
0d4ffdbd: ;The DGJTNDT variable is set to the admission date stored in the DT node of file 393.
ad3301b4: ;If the DT node is not defined, the DGJTNDT variable is set to an empty string.
af3a4e5a: ;The variable DGJTDEL is set to the discharge details from the DELAYED ORDERS file 40.8.

c3d8c4ed: ;The routine sets various variables related to the patient's information, including the patient's name (DGJTNM), ID (DGJTPTID), and the window header (DGJTHDR). It also calls the PID^VADPT6 routine to retrieve the patient's ID.
99e98f17: ;The routine calls the DGJTVW2 routine.
afa3dc42: ;The routine sets variables RTE and RTYPE to be used in the LATEST^RTUTL3 call, which retrieves the latest patient record information.
1e9166d8: ;The variable X is set to an empty string.
456ddbb5: ;The DGJVAL variable is set to a string that indicates whether the user can edit the primary physician based on their security key and the type of record being viewed.
1d7866a8: ;The SETSTR^VALM1 routine is called to set the value of X with the DGJVAL string.
2ad307f4: ;The DGJVAL variable is set to the treating specialty from the 7th piece of the 0th node of file 393.
14693d96: ;The SETSTR^VALM1 routine is called to set the value of X with the DGJVAL string.
74fde8f0: ;The DGJVAL variable is set to the borrower information from the RTDATA string.
d6fedf09: ;The SETSTR^VALM1 routine is called to set the value of X with the borrower information string.
